semiconductor_relevance: High — Sunshine Duqm specializes in the production of semiconductor-grade CVD diamonds, which are critical for high-power electronics and advanced quantum computing applications.
summary: Sunshine Duqm LLC is a leading provider of CVD diamonds specifically designed for the semiconductor industry, offering products that provide exceptional thermal conductivity and electrical insulation. Their diamonds are manufactured using advanced Chemical Vapor Deposition technology, making them suitable for high-power electronic devices and quantum computing applications.
capabilities: CVD diamond manufacturing for semiconductor applications
High thermal conductivity and electrical insulation properties
Customizable nitrogen and boron concentration levels

regional_presence.Oman: Sunshine Duqm has embarked on CVD diamond manufacturing in Oman, focusing on high-quality, precision-made lab-grown diamonds.
